1. (Currently amended) A speaker comprising a permanent magnet (2), and a coil (8) positioned around the permanent magnet and attached to a membrane (10), wherein the membrane (10) comprises an elastomer of thickness less than 0.3mm and with a Young's modulus below 100MPa, __wherein the elastomer is selected to provide a specific acoustic response characteristic not achievable with butyl rubber alone__.

2. (Currently amended) A speaker as claimed in claim 1, wherein the elastomer (10) comprises a silicone __having a Young's modulus below 100MPa and selected for its dampening and suspension properties in combination with the specified thickness__.

3. (Previously presented) A speaker as claimed in claim 1 or 2, wherein the membrane (10) is injection moulded.

4. (Previously presented) A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a single layer monolithic structure.

5. (Previously presented) A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the speaker further comprises a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane (10) to the coil (8).

6. (Currently amended) A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, further comprising a support structure (32,34) which defines a back volume (36), wherein the back volume is less than 1cm³ __and is specifically designed to achieve the low frequency resonant response of the speaker__.

7. (Currently amended) A speaker as claimed in claim 6, wherein the back volume (36) is less than 0.5cm³ __and is configured as an integral part of the speaker design to control resonant frequency__.

8. (Previously presented) A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein the resonant frequency is below 300 Hz.

9. (Previously presented) A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein the resonant frequency is below 250 Hz.

10. (Currently amended) A method of manufacturing a speaker, comprising: forming a membrane (10) from an elastomer, wherein the membrane has thickness less than 0.3mm and a Young's modulus below 100MPa __selected to provide a specific acoustic response__; attaching a coil (8) to the membrane; and assembling the speaker by suspending the membrane (10), such that the coil (8) is positioned around a permanent magnet (2).

11. (Currently amended) A method as claimed in claim 10, wherein the elastomer (10) comprises silicone __selected for its dampening and suspension properties in combination with the specified thickness and Young's modulus__.

12. (Previously presented) A method as claimed in claim 10 or 11, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a single layer monolithic structure.

13. (Previously presented) A method as claimed in claim 10, 11 or 12, wherein the membrane (10) is formed using injection moulding.

14. (Previously presented) A method as claimed in any one of claims 10 to 13, wherein the membrane (10) is formed with a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the method further comprises providing a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane to the coil (8).
